works.title: Enterprise Integration Patterns: Designing, Building, and Deploying Messaging Solutions
works.note: Route anchor: the 65-pattern messaging catalog that names and defines the bulk of this route's messaging elements; enterpriseintegrationpatterns.com/books1.html loaded live confirming title/authors/year/ISBN.

works.title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture Vol. 2: Patterns for Concurrent and Networked Objects
works.authors: Douglas C. Schmidt, Michael Stal, Hans Rohnert, Frank Buschmann
works.note: Names and gives the full pattern treatment of Acceptor-Connector (connection setup decoupled from service processing in networked programs).

works.title: Patterns for Fault Tolerant Software
works.note: Names Acknowledgement as a fault-detection pattern: confirm liveness/receipt of communication partners via positive acks.

works.title: Object-Oriented Programming with ANSI-C
works.note: Phase-1 naming source for callback as a C mechanism (function pointers as customization/notification hooks).

works.title: C Interfaces and Implementations: Techniques for Creating Reusable Software
works.note: Pervasive disciplined use of callback + void* closure ('cl') parameters across its library interfaces - the catalog treatment of the callback-with-context-pointer idiom in C.

works.title: Release It! Design and Deploy Production-Ready Software, 2nd ed.
works.note: Names Handshaking as a stability pattern: cooperative demand throttling between communicating endpoints.

works.title: MicroC/OS-III: The Real-Time Kernel
works.note: Defines and teaches RTOS message mailboxes and message queues as kernel IPC objects (uC/OS-II mailboxes; uC/OS-III message queues).

works.title: Design Patterns for Embedded Systems in C: An Embedded Software Engineering Toolkit
works.note: Phase-1 naming source for message queue in the embedded/concurrency sense (Message Queuing Pattern, C implementation).

works.title: Real-Time Design Patterns; Doing Hard Time; Real-Time UML
works.note: Real-Time Design Patterns names Shared Memory as a task-communication pattern (rendezvous via shared data regions with access protection).

works.title: Mastering the FreeRTOS Real-Time Kernel
works.note: Queue-management chapter teaches producer/consumer task communication over queues and the length-1 queue-as-mailbox usage - the living embedded practice treatment of these mechanisms.

works.title: Practical UML Statecharts in C/C++: Event-Driven Programming for Embedded Systems, 2nd ed.
works.note: QF framework chapters teach active-object event queues and in-process publish-subscribe event delivery as concrete embedded mechanisms.

works.title: The Art of Designing Embedded Systems; The Firmware Handbook; ganssle.com articles
works.note: Ganssle's 'Bit Banging' article (Embedded Systems Programming, Dec 1991; ganssle.com/articles/auart.htm, loaded live) teaches software-implemented UART serial I/O on GPIO pins - the catalog-grade upgrade over the Wikipedia-only naming; claimed under the corpus's existing Ganssle-materials entry.

works.title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture Vol. 1: A System of Patterns
works.authors: Frank Buschmann, Regine Meunier, Hans Rohnert, Peter Sommerlad, Michael Stal
works.note: Names Forwarder-Receiver, Client-Dispatcher-Server, and Publisher-Subscriber; ISBN/year/publisher confirmed live via hillside.net book record + Schmidt's POSA series page (Wiley/O'Reilly pages blocked this session).

works.title: Pattern-Oriented Software Architecture Vol. 4: A Pattern Language for Distributed Computing
works.authors: Frank Buschmann, Kevlin Henney, Douglas C. Schmidt
works.note: Its 114-pattern distributed-computing language includes Half-Object plus Protocol (component partitioning) - the modern consolidated treatment of Meszaros's PLoPD-1 pattern; dblp record loaded live confirming ISBN/year.

works.note: Names Gateway ('an object that encapsulates access to an external system or resource'); martinfowler.com/books/eaa.html + eaaCatalog/gateway.html loaded live confirming ISBN and pattern membership.

works.note: Fowler's post-PoEAA draft catalog: EventAggregator.html (2004) and DomainEvent.html (2005) loaded live - the naming/defining pages for Event Aggregator and the standard free treatment of Domain Event.

works.title: Event Delegation - The Modern JavaScript Tutorial

works.title: The Little Book of Semaphores

works.title: The Tail at Scale
works.note: The canon paper naming hedged requests (send a duplicate request after a delay, take the first reply) among tail-latency-tolerant techniques; dblp record loaded live.

works.title: Implementing Remote Procedure Calls
works.authors: Andrew D. Birrell, Bruce Jay Nelson

works.title: RFC 896: Congestion Control in IP/TCP Internetworks
works.note: The primary standard describing small-packet coalescing (inhibit new segments while unacked data is outstanding) - later known as Nagle's algorithm; RFC loaded live.

works.title: TCP/IP Illustrated, Volume 1: The Protocols
works.note: The canonical protocol-mechanics text: teaches sliding-window flow control and Nagle's algorithm with live traces; InformIT publisher page loaded live confirming ISBN (pub. 1993, copyright 1994).

works.title: Interest management for distributed virtual environments: A survey
works.authors: Elvis S. Liu, Georgios K. Theodoropoulos
works.note: The catalog-grade survey of interest management (aura/region/class-based filtering in networked games and simulations) - upgrades the element from tech-report-only naming; dblp record loaded live.

notes: All 43 route-r2 elements are covered by at least one catalog-grade work; zero gaps. Anchor is Hohpe & Woolf EIP (19 of 43 elements). 11 memberships reuse existing corpus ids (posa2, hanmer, schreiner, hanson, nygard, labrosse, douglasspatternsc, douglassrtcorpus, freertosbook, samekbook, ganssle); the seeded samekbook and freertosbook memberships were confirmed useful (QF publish-subscribe/event queues; FreeRTOS queue-as-mailbox and producer-consumer). 18 new works, 17 verified against live primary/authoritative pages this session, 1 unverified (dddref: domainlanguage.com 403'd; its element domain-event stays verified-reachable via Fowler's eaaDev Domain Event page). Wiley, O'Reilly, and ACM DL all returned 403 to direct fetches; ACM-published papers were verified via their dblp records (DOI-bearing authoritative catalog), POSA1 via hillside.net + Schmidt's official POSA series page. Bit-banging (Wikipedia-only naming in Phase 1) was upgraded to Ganssle's 1991 'Bit Banging' article, claimed under the existing ganssle corpus entry which already clusters his articles. Old naming sources got modern companions per the mission rule: EWD123 (1965) + Little Book of Semaphores + freertosbook for producer-consumer; Hoare 1978 + Effective Go for csp-channel; RFC 896 + Stevens for Nagle's algorithm. Seeded POSA4 was included only for half-object-plus-protocol (confirmed in its component-partitioning pattern list); Reactive Streams spec, OTP design principles, and the MPI standard were rejected - no r2 element needs them (backpressure/supervisor are other routes). Borderline-tagged elements (wire-tap, scatter-gather, publish-subscribe-channel, hedged-request, RPC, etc.) were covered like any other per the over-inclusion-with-honest-tags house rule.
